# Copilot instructions

This repository is continued across several AI tools and chats. Before doing anything:

1. Read `HANDOFF.md` at the repository root, all of it. It holds the current state, what works, the next tasks, the absolute rules and the map of the documentation tree.
2. Read only the `Docs/` files that `HANDOFF.md` section 6 routes your task to, then the code.
3. When you finish, follow `HANDOFF.md` section 8: update `HANDOFF.md`, `Docs/Project/REQUIREMENTS.md` and the topic documents you touched, run the tests, commit and push to the `Network` branch.

Reply to the user in Korean. Code comments and commit messages are in English.
Never mark something as verified unless the user saw it working in Unity or Steam.
